metadata.title: Hierarchically Hyperbolic Surface-by-surface Groups
metadata.abstract: We give many examples of surface bundles over surfaces whose fundamental groups are hierarchically hyperbolic by showing that extensions of surface groups constructed by the third author and Reid (LR surface groups) are hierarchically hyperbolic. This is facilitated by a new combination theorem for bundles of hyperbolic graphs over a hyperbolic base. This result differs from previous combination theorems for graph bundles by being applicable to bundles where the fibers are not properly embedded. We apply our combination theorem to establish the hyperbolicity of certain graph bundles that arise naturally from extensions of parabolically geometrically finite (PGF) subgroups of mapping class groups. These subgroups include LR surface groups, finitely generated Veech groups, free products of multi-twist groups, and many other examples created by a theorem of Udall. When the PGF groups have cyclic peripherals, hyperbolicity of our graph bundle is the key milestone towards showing that the extension groups are hierarchically hyperbolic.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: 曲面扩张群的层级双曲性
analysis.workSummary: 证明 LR 曲面群所给曲面丛扩张群层级双曲，建立允许纤维非 proper 嵌入的双曲图丛组合定理，并应用于映射类群的抛物几何有限子群扩张。
analysis.breakthrough: 扩大可证明层级双曲性的曲面丛及映射类群扩张例子。
analysis.limitations: 相关扩张的层级双曲结论包含外围子群等条件，不能推广到任意曲面丛群。
